slides.title: Nobody Is Listed Until They Have Shipped
slides.subtitle: hire.refactored.ai, the Hire module, read at commit 24b94f6
slides.caption: Employers see plenty of claims about AI engineers and very little proof. This directory puts the proof first.
A person appears here only once a case study about work they built is approved and published. No case study, no listing.

slides.title: Work is shown only as published case studies.
slides.subtitle: Unproven projects are stripped at the server, not hidden on the page.
slides.caption: Inside a profile the same rule holds. A project without a published case study, and the commits from its repository, never leave the server.
With booking off, an employer asks for an introduction and the Colaberry team makes it. Candidates' contact details are never shown.

slides.title: The candidate decides, one request per time.
slides.subtitle: Open times in the candidate's own zone, decided under a lock.
slides.caption: With booking on, the page offers only open times in the candidate's zone. Each request is decided under a lock, then waits for the candidate to accept, suggest another time or decline.

slides.title: Coach the voice, never read the face.
slides.subtitle: Pace, filler words and voice, against published targets.
slides.caption: Candidates can record an intro video in the browser. The coach measures pace, filler words and voice against published targets, and the face is not analysed.

rows: listed engineers have a published case study
Hire modules have a test file of their own name
commits name an AI coding assistant as co-author
slides.caption: Six of six listed engineers have a published case study behind them. Twenty of twenty eight modules have a test file of their own name. All sixteen commits name an AI coding assistant as co-author.

rows: Hire site events left uncategorised, after a fix on 14 November
slides.caption: Before a fix on fourteen November most visits to the site landed in a catch-all category, and today none do. No listed engineer has switched booking on yet.

slides.title: What this record cannot show yet.
slides.subtitle: Whether a listing leads to a hire.
slides.caption: No interview has been booked, so whether a listing leads to a hire is still unmeasured. The record says so plainly.

slides.title: Proof before the profile. The decision with the candidate.
slides.subtitle: Colaberry platform team
slides.caption: The directory cannot list anyone without a published case study, and an employer's request waits for the candidate to decide.
